messages.en:
{07 34 00}Good morning!{01 01 00} Are you here
for your morning cup of
java?
{07 00 00}Oh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} It's just that{01 00 00 05 00} you
really look like you could
use a pick-me-up.
messages.et:
{07 34 00}Tere hommikust!{01 01 00} Kas tulid
oma hommikuse
kohvitassi järele?
{07 00 00}Oh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Lihtsalt{01 00 00 05 00} sa näed
välja, nagu kuluks
sulle turgutus ära.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Good morning!{01 00 00 0a 00} Fancy seeing
you here! {01 00 00 0a 00}Are you on your
way in to work?
{07 34 00}The coffee smells utterly
divine, doesn't it? {01 00 00 0a 00}It just
opens up your eyes!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere hommikust!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kena sind
siin näha! {01 00 00 0a 00}Kas oled
tööle minemas?
{07 34 00}Kohv lõhnab lausa
jumalikult, kas pole? {01 00 00 0a 00}See
avab silmad!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hello there! {01 00 00 05 00}Have you come
in for a cup of coffee
before heading to work?
{07 34 00}My, it must be so hard
to wake up so early in the
morning every day.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere sulle! {01 00 00 05 00}Kas tulid
kohvitassi järele enne
tööle minekut?
{07 34 00}Ohoh, kui raske peab
olema igal hommikul nii
vara ärgata.

messages.en:
{07 33 00}I dream of sharing a cup 
of coffee with that special
someone.
{07 35 00}Do you think that's childish
of me?{02 00 00 0b 0c}
No!
You big baby!
messages.et:
{07 33 00}Unistan sellest, et jagada 
kohvitassi selle erilise
inimesega.
{07 35 00}Kas see on sinu arust
lapsik?{02 00 00 0b 0c}
Ei!
Sa suur beebi!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}My coffee would taste even
better if only that special
someone were here.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mu kohv maitseks veelgi
paremini, kui see eriline
inimene oleks siin{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 34 00}No, you're right.{01 01 00} Coffee is
for more mature palates,
after all.
Plus, {01 00 00 05 00}I put only two 
small scoops of sugar
in mine.
messages.et:
{07 34 00}Ei, sul on õigus.{01 01 00} Kohv on
ikkagi küpsemale
maitsele.
Pealegi, {01 00 00 05 00}panen ainult 
kaks väikest lusikatäit
suhkrut.

messages.en:
{07 34 00}What a beautiful, sunny
morning. {01 00 00 0a 00}It makes you happy
to be alive, doesn't it?
We can't let the sun
outshine us!{01 00 00 05 00} We have to
beam, too!
messages.et:
{07 34 00}Milline ilus päikseline
hommik. {01 00 00 0a 00}See teeb rõõmu,
et oled elus, kas pole?
Me ei tohi päiksele
alla jääda!{01 00 00 05 00} Peame ka
särama!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}A hot cup of coffee on a
rainy morning {01 00 00 05 00}chases away
the chill and the sleepies.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuum kohvitass vihmasel
hommikul {01 00 00 05 00}peletab külma
ja unisuse.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'm so lucky!{01 00 00 05 00} I have the
best dreams!{01 01 00}{07 36 00} But I always
seem to forget them.
{07 00 00}I'll tell you about some of 
them the next time I
remember.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mul on nii vedanud!{01 00 00 05 00} Näen
parimaid unenägusid!{01 01 00}{07 36 00} Aga
unustan need alati ära.
{07 00 00}Räägin sulle mõnest 
järgmine kord, kui
meenub.

messages.en:
{07 35 00}Even if{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 06}Phyllis{ff 00 00 00} weren't
around,{01 00 00 05 00} there'd still be a
lot I could do, but{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 36 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} that's something I 
should keep to myself.{01 01 00}
Forget about it.
messages.et:
{07 35 00}Isegi kui{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 06}Phyllist{ff 00 00 00} poleks
siin,{01 00 00 05 00} saaksin palju
teha, aga{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 36 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} see on midagi, mida 
peaksin endale hoidma.{01 01 00}
Unusta ära.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Time for work?{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh, I still
have time before my shift.

Don't you have to be
somewhere, though?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Aeg tööle?{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh, mul on
veel aega enne vahetust.

Aga kas sina ei pea
kuhugi minema?

messages.en:
{07 35 00}If even a clueless boy's
noticed it,{01 00 00 05 00} maybe it IS
true.
messages.et:
{07 35 00}Kui isegi asjatundmatu
poiss on märganud,{01 00 00 05 00} siis
ehk ONGI tõsi.

messages.en:
{07 35 00}I really{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00}envy how you
always just say what's on
your mind.
messages.et:
{07 35 00}Ma tõesti{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00}kadestan, kuidas
sa alati lihtsalt ütled,
mida mõtled.
